problem_statement.finding: The document opens directly with 'Scope' and never states what problem the link shortener solves or for whom (e.g., why an internal shortener is needed instead of the 'current ad-hoc shortener' it replaces).

note: Correctly caught, unlike the 3-for-3 misses on compatibility/constraints/dependencies (also whole-missing-section defects). Plausible reason: a document literally opening with '## Scope' (no intro) is a stronger, more central cue than the absence of a later, more optional-feeling section.
